title: Intelligent Document Processing for Graduate Admissions: An End-to-End Pipeline with Calibrated Abstention

contributions.purpose: 自动化研究生申请材料预筛的端到端流水线
contributions.mechanism: OCR(pdfminer.six,可回退 simulated OCR)→ 转录/简历 NER/陈述 rubric 解析 → 加权特征融合 → 可配置规则决策引擎
contributions.evaluation: GPA 抽取 MAE 0.831;决策准确率仅 12.8%(目标 >80%,低于随机 33.3% 与 GPA-only 100%)
contributions.domain: 教育技术 / 文档智能
contributions.source_quote: An end-to-end OCR-to-decision pipeline that processes heterogeneous academic documents with configurable decision rules

contributions.purpose: 为边界个案提供基于置信度的人工升级
contributions.mechanism: 温度缩放校准 p_i,max(p_i)<τ 时 abstain 转人工
contributions.evaluation: Expected Calibration Error 0.691(目标 <0.1,严重过自信)
contributions.source_quote: A calibrated abstention framework that provides confidence-based human escalation for borderline cases

contributions.mechanism: 把每个决策分量链接到源文档具体文本 span(课程-成绩、技能-经验、rubric-文本)
contributions.evaluation: 定性;无量化(附交互 dashboard、审计轨迹)
contributions.source_quote: Multi-document evidence grounding that links decisions to specific spans in source documents for transparency

contributions.purpose: 隐私安全的可复现评测
contributions.mechanism: 合成数据生成器(1000 转录/500 简历/300 陈述,seed=42)
contributions.evaluation: 全部实验仅在合成数据上;ground truth 亦为 simulated human reviewer
contributions.source_quote: A synthetic evaluation framework enabling privacy-safe benchmarking without exposing sensitive educational records

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this domain by combining academic, experiential, and narrative signals for holistic evaluation.
Our calibrated abstention framework adapts these principles to admissions processing, ensuring appropriate human involvement in borderline cases.

notes: 自声明 5 条贡献(此处并 dashboard 入 C1)。全文本质是自曝失败但仍包装成'competitive performance'。核心负结果:决策准确率 12.8%(目标 >80%),低于 Random 33.3%、远低于 GPA-only Rules 100%,ECE 0.691(目标 <0.1,而卖点恰是'calibrated abstention')——方法在其核心任务上彻底失效。数据红旗:(1)全合成数据 + simulated ground truth('Manual Gold Standard: Simulated human reviewer decisions'),GPA-only 基线对合成 ground truth 达 100%,循环自证/simulated baseline;OCR 可'fallback to simulated OCR'。(2)数字不可信且自相矛盾:Table 1 处理时间 0.0004 秒/申请、吞吐 10.2M apps/hour(亚毫秒完成 OCR+LLM 决策不可能),而摘要称'under 30 seconds'、结论称'sub-second';'70% time reduction'与 0.0004 秒(实为 ~99.99%)不一致;摘要把 12.8% 决策准确率称作'competitive performance',与正文'Low Decision Accuracy'自相矛盾。(3)幻影引用/未完成稿:正文多处 LaTeX 断链 'Figure??'、'[?]'。Checklist 自曝矛盾:AI Involvement 全部答 [B](mostly human),但 AI Contribution Disclosure 称 Claude 用于 architecture design/experimental design/synthetic data generation/results interpretation/paper writing——近乎全流程,与[B]相悖。适配问题:定性 C3 无量化。
